archero-alpha

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AssetManager
    Static utility class for loading and caching game assets.
    BaseEnemy
    Abstract base class for all enemy types.
    BaseWeapon
    Abstract base class for all weapon types.
    Boss
    Multi-phase boss enemy with mechanics that evolve as HP decreases.
    Bow
    Multi-shot weapon that fires three arrows in a spread pattern.
    Collidable
    Contract for objects that participate in collision detection.
    CollisionSystem
    Handles collision detection and resolution for all game entities.
    Damageable
    Contract for objects that can take damage and have health points.
    EnemyType
    Enum defining all enemy types and providing a factory method for creation.
    Entity
    Abstract base class for all game entities (player, enemies).
    GameApp
    Main JavaFX application class for the Archero-like roguelike game.
    GameContext
    Central coordinator for the entire game application.
    GameLoop
    Main game loop running at approximately 60 FPS.
    GameOver
    Game over screen displayed when player dies.
    GameState
    Enum representing the current state of the game application.
    Goblin
    Ranged archer enemy that tries to maintain distance from the player.
    Golem
    Large, slow tank enemy with very high HP and damage.
    Gun
    Basic starting weapon that fires a single fast projectile.
    HealUpgrade
    Special upgrade that fully restores the player's HP.
    HitBox
    Immutable axis-aligned bounding box for collision detection.
    Hud
    Heads-up display overlay showing HP bar, room number, and score during gameplay.
    InputHandler
    Tracks which keyboard keys are currently pressed.
    Launcher
    Entry point launcher that delegates to GameApp.
    MainMenu
    Main menu screen with Play, Settings, and Quit buttons.
    Player
    The player character controlled by user input.
    Projectile
    Represents a moving projectile fired by the player or enemies.
    Renderable
    Contract for objects that can be drawn to the screen.
    RoomDifficulty
    Enum representing the difficulty tier of a room.
    RoomManager
    Generates an infinite sequence of room templates following a 16-room cycle.
    RoomTemplate
    Immutable template defining the properties of a room.
    ScoreManager
    Tracks player score, kill count, and rooms cleared.
    Settings
    Settings screen for adjusting music and SFX volume.
    Slime
    Small, fast melee enemy that chases the player directly.
    Staff
    Slow, high-damage weapon that fires piercing orbs.
    Stat
    Enum defining the player stats that can be upgraded.
    StatUpgrade
    Upgrade that increases one of the player's stats.
    Updatable
    Contract for objects that can be updated each frame based on elapsed time.
    Upgrade
    Abstract base class for all upgrade types.
    UpgradeManager
    Generates random upgrade choices for the player.
    UpgradeScreen
    Upgrade selection screen shown after clearing certain rooms.
    UpgradeType
    Enum defining the tier of upgrade offered to the player.
    Vec2
    Immutable 2D vector class for position and velocity calculations.
    WeaponUpgrade
    Upgrade that adds a new weapon to the player's inventory.
    World
    Represents the game world for a single room.
